quests.title: The Dead Patch at St James
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The number three green at St James has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since a wet Monday, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. This is the third time I have had this conversation. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, St James
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by a wet Monday, which means finding $43 that the St James club does not have. It started small, the way these things do. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: $43, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The St James Membership Count
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. Our books say 60 members at St James and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, St James
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Since the back of seven somebody has been going round the St James greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at St James
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. There is a chest freezer that hums in D in the chest freezer behind the bar at St James and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. You will see what I mean the second you get there. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, St James
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Circular Quay now, and he owes St James an explanation about the drainage. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Tascott

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Tascott
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Tascott at twenty past four, because it is not going home. It started small, the way these things do. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: follow it as far as Point Clare
wherever it stops

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Someone has been walking out of Tascott with a socket set at a time since Thursdays, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$45 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Tascott Price Board
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Head office says the Tascott board has been wrong since Thursdays and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. You will see what I mean the second you get there. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The bloke who runs the site at Point Clare has had the same trouble Tascott has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Just do not come back empty-handed.

whatever he says, I want it word for word
